items.title: Aetna wants policymakers to fix the No Surprises Act claim fight system - BenefitsPRO
items.reason: Aetna's advocacy for policy fixes to the No Surprises Act claim dispute system directly addresses implementation challenges with the IDR process and balance-billing protections, which are core to No Surprises Act enforcement.
items.summary: Aetna is calling on policymakers to reform the No Surprises Act's claim dispute resolution system, signaling industry concerns about the current implementation framework. While the excerpt does not specify which aspects of the Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) process or claim-handling procedures Aetna seeks to modify, the insurer's formal advocacy indicates operational or regulatory friction points in how the law is being executed. This reflects ongoing implementation challenges within the No Surprises Act ecosystem that may affect how health plans, providers, and patients navigate balance-billing protections and claim adjudication. Revenue-cycle teams should monitor whether Aetna's push leads to regulatory guidance changes or legislative amendments that could alter IDR procedures, appeal timelines, or documentation requirements.
